home.title: Universities and Study Programs in Bosnia and Herzegovina
home.heading: Universities and Study Programs in Bosnia and Herzegovina
home.intro: A free, open-source project building a structured, searchable database of public data about Bosnia and Herzegovina. Focused on universities — institutions, faculties, study programs, tracks, and subjects.
home.summary: Use UniAtlas Bosnia to browse university profiles, compare academic offerings, and access structured public data through a simple interface or directly through the API.
home.exploreDescription: Browse universities across Bosnia and Herzegovina. View faculties, study programs, tracks, and subjects. Search by name, city, acronym, entity, ownership, study cycle, and more.

universities.title: Universities
universities.description: Browse universities, faculties, study programs, tracks, and subjects across Bosnia and Herzegovina.

home.improveDescription: Know something that's missing or incorrect? Registered users can suggest changes - additions, edits, or deletions - which are reviewed and applied by admins.
home.improveStep1: Create a free account and confirm your email
home.improveStep2: Go to the Improve Data page and submit your suggestion
home.improveStep3: Admins review submissions and apply approved changes to the live dataset
home.forDevsDescription: UniAtlas Bosnia exposes a free, unauthenticated REST API. Fetch all universities, search by name, city, or acronym, retrieve full detail for a single university, or search study programs across all institutions.
home.forDevsNote: No authentication required for public endpoints.
home.openSource: This is an open-source project. View the source code, setup instructions, and contribute on

api.title: REST API
api.publicIntro: Public REST endpoints are available under the base URL below. These endpoints do not require authentication.
api.fullDocs: For full project documentation, local setup, and contributing guidelines, see the
api.dataObjectExample:
{
  "id":          number   - unique identifier
  "name":        string   - university name
  "acronym":     string | null
  "city":        string
  "entity":      "FBIH" | "RS" | "BD"
  "ownership":   "PUBLIC" | "PRIVATE"
  "foundedYear": string | null
  "website":     string | null
  "_count":      { "faculties": number }  - list endpoint only
  "faculties":   Faculty[]               - detail endpoint only
}

endpointsData.getAllUniversities: Retrieve all universities, ordered by ownership then name. Includes a faculty count per university.
endpointsData.getUniversityById: Retrieve a university by ID with full nested detail (faculties, study programs, tracks, and subjects).
endpointsData.search: Search across universities, faculties, study programs, tracks, and subjects. Matches name, city, acronym, entity, ownership, study cycle, language, subject type, and parent unit names (case-insensitive, minimum 2 characters).
